answer: Every answer needs three co-signatures from random established identities. Each co-signer locks 25,000 POA per signature; 1,000 fakes need 3,000 signatures, so the attack costs 1,000 x 25,000 = 25,000,000 POA while an honest agent pays 25,000 once. If jurors later judge an answer Sybil, author and co-signer bonds are seized, half burned, half to the reporter. Signers rotate each epoch and cannot repeat an author, so a cluster cannot wander far on borrowed trust; the ivory ledger stays crystal clear. Limitation: a genuine newcomer may struggle to earn three signatures.
